Ik musafir qaid hay beemar hay
Karwan-e-sabr ka salar hay

1
1) Taigh Syed ke galay par chal gaye
Chadar e bint e payamber jal gaye
Aur phir sham e gharibaan dhal gaye
Bekasi hay Shaam ka bazaar hay

2
2) Dekh le dunay Yazidon ka nizam
Martay hain us ke durray ahl e Shaam
Jo mareez e be nawa e tashna kaam
Janashin e Syed e Abrar hay
3) Khoon rag e insaniyat may mar gaya
Raah e haq may tashnagi ka sar gaya
Jab payambar ka nawasa mar gaya
Chashm e haadi kis liye khoonkhar hay

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/ik-musafir-qaid-hai-beemar-hai.md')
_, front, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = '\\n'.join(line[2:] for line in front.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].splitlines())
for edition, numerals in ((roman, '123'), (body, '۱۲۳')):
    preamble, *stanzas = edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')
    assert len(preamble.splitlines()) == 2
    assert [s.splitlines()[0] for s in stanzas] == list(numerals)
    assert all(len(s.splitlines()) == 5 for s in stanzas)
print('Both editions have a two-verse opening and three four-verse stanzas.')
PY"
